name: cfd-sparse-field-reconstruction-inference
description: 稀疏/缺损CFD流场重构推理任务卡：加载训练好的INR或扩散桥模型，对测试集构造与真实采集一致的低分辨、稀疏或缺损输入并执行重构，恢复物理单位和边界，保存逐样本重构结果、误差场、频谱与统计剖面。适用于CFD缺失区补全场景的第四步推断评估。

evidence_papers.title: PEINR: A Physics-enhanced Implicit Neural Representation for High-Fidelity Flow Field Reconstruction
Inpainting Computational Fluid Dynamics with Deep Learning
SCoReT: Super-Resolution Compression and Reconstruction of Turbulent Flows
